documentation.content: A backup job had no successful execution in 26 h: the schedule did not call, the workflow failed or the job failed. Runbook: docs/operacao/backup.md (ADR 0082).

conditions.displayName: No successful backup job execution in 26 h

conditionAbsent.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = monitoring.regex.full_match("sacou-backup(-test)?") AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "succeeded"
